skills.name: Magical Trample
skills.description: Pierce the air with a shrill whistle, calling your mount forth to trample enemies in a line. This ability cannot be re-activated while your mount is already attacking.

skills.name: Rending Slashes
skills.description:
Slice an enemy with both weapons to cause deep lacerations, dealing |cffffff1841|r Bleed Damage with each weapon and causing them to bleed for an additional |cffffff8410|r Bleed Damage over |cffffff20|r seconds.

Enemies hit by the initial hit are afflicted with the Hemorrhaging status effect.

You also reduce their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

skills.name: Quick Cloak
skills.description:
Envelop yourself in a protective cloak of razors, gaining Major Evasion for |cffffff30|r seconds, reducing damage from area attacks by |cffffff20|r%. 

Every |cffffff2|r seconds the shrapnel will pulse, dealing |cffffff1080|r Physical Damage to all enemies within |cffffff5|r meters.

You also gain Major Expedition for |cffffff4|r seconds, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r%.

skills.name: Gripping Shards
skills.description:
Conjure icy shards around you to skewer enemies in the area, immobilizing them for |cffffff3|r seconds and dealing |cffffff955|r Frost Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff12|r seconds.

Enemies hit are overcome with bitter cold, reducing their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff3|r seconds.

Damage done is based on your Max Health and has a higher chance to apply the Chilled status effect.

skills.name: Flawless Dawnbreaker
skills.description:
Arm yourself with Meridia's sacred sword and dispense her retribution, dealing |cffffff8557|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you and an additional |cffffff9252|r Physical Damage over |cffffff6|r seconds.

After activating, your Weapon and Spell Damage is increased by |cffffff300|r for |cffffff20|r seconds.
